Select a shader source file from local storage, a web URL, or a resource location.
The file must contain plain text GLSL fragment shader code (not binary).
Accepted entry points:
- Shadertoy style: void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord)
- Direct fragment style: void main()
In direct mode, output should be written to an out vec4 variable (recommended) or gl_FragColor compatibility.
Supported local file extension: .txt only.
Important: extension is only used for filtering; the content must still be fragment shader code.
